description: Change a deck (id or name): its name, format (commander | pdh (Pauper Commander) | dc (Duel Commander) | standard | pioneer | modern | legacy | vintage | pauper | casual), description, or who leads it. commander / partner take a card reference; null removes that commander (the card stays in the list). A newly named commander that the list lacks is added to the main deck. Fields left out are unchanged. companion takes a card reference (null: none; the card stays in the list): a card with the Companion ability, moved to or added to the sideboard (outside the 100 in a commander format); deck_health checks its condition and names any card that breaks it. Changing the format changes which rules deck_health and deck_stats apply; it never changes the list. lang sets the language the deck's rows ask for (Scryfall's code: de, ja, zhs…; null any) unless a row has its own: a preference, so a copy in another language still counts and is offered marked. open_to_trade:true PUBLISHES this deck's claimed copies on every tradelist the user publishes, each naming this deck (trading one breaks it): say so and ask before turning it on. The deck stays whole. play is how the deck is played (every deck starts casual): tournament counts a copy only a proxy covers as missing, so deck_status, the buylist, its wantlist link, trade matches and posts list that card until a real copy replaces the proxy; the proxy stays in the deck, and nothing is written to the list. casual plays proxies, and a deck with them is not tournament legal.
